name: Grilled rice paper
summary: Crisp rice sheet grilled with toppings, folded and eaten from the paper — the Da Lat night-market snack.
origin: Street counters at the night market and around the central market slope.
howToEat: Fold the sheet while it is hot so the toppings stay inside.
Point at toppings if you do not eat chili or dried shrimp.
seoTitle: Grilled rice paper — Da Lat banh trang nuong
seoDescription: Grilled rice-paper snacks at Da Lat night market. Stall prices are check on arrival.
